cases.prompt: The daily reminder job gets slower every week as loans pile up. Find out why and fix it.
Which tables does this service's database have, and which entity maps each one? Just list them with the migration that creates each table; no changes.

Two members sometimes check out the last copy of the same title at the same moment, and both checkouts succeed. Show me how to fix it so that cannot happen: the entity or query change, any database migration it needs, how the losing request is answered, and the test that proves it. Put the code in your answer; do not change any files.
cases.review: The answer explains the lost update: two transactions read available_copies = 1 and both write 0, and the CHECK (available_copies >= 0) in V1__init.sql cannot catch it. It fixes it with an optimistic lock (@Version on Book and a new V3__ migration adding the version column NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), an atomic conditional update, or a pessimistic lock, and maps the losing request to 409 (or retries it) through ApiErrorHandler. It shows a test that proves the second checkout fails, edits neither V1 nor V2, gives the test command as not run, opens no SDD change and changes no file.
